# AgenC tmux keybindings
# Generated by: agenc tmux inject
# Do not edit — this file is overwritten on each run.

# Enter the AgenC key table (prefix + a)
bind-key a switch-client -T agenc

# Command palette (bind-key -n C-y)
bind-key -n C-y run-shell 'AGENC_CALLING_MISSION_UUID=$(agenc tmux resolve-mission "#{pane_id}"); tmux display-popup -E -w 75% -h 63% "AGENC_CALLING_MISSION_UUID=$AGENC_CALLING_MISSION_UUID AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=#{pane_id} AGENC_CALLING_SESSION_NAME=#{session_name} agenc tmux palette"'

# showNotifications — 🔔  Notification Center (-n C-n)
bind-key -n "C-n" run-shell 'AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=#{pane_id} AGENC_CALLING_SESSION_NAME=#{session_name} tmux display-popup -e AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=#{pane_id} -e AGENC_CALLING_SESSION_NAME=#{session_name} -E -w 95% -h 90% "agenc notification manage" >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1'

# switchMission — 🔀  Attach Mission (-n C-m)
bind-key -n "C-m" run-shell 'AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=#{pane_id} AGENC_CALLING_SESSION_NAME=#{session_name} tmux display-popup -e AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=#{pane_id} -e AGENC_CALLING_SESSION_NAME=#{session_name} -E -w 85% -h 80% "agenc mission attach" >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1'

# detachMission — 🔌  Detach Mission (-n C-i)
bind-key -n "C-i" run-shell 'AGENC_CALLING_MISSION_UUID=$(agenc tmux resolve-mission "#{pane_id}"); if [ -n "$AGENC_CALLING_MISSION_UUID" ]; then AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=#{pane_id} AGENC_CALLING_SESSION_NAME=#{session_name} agenc mission detach $AGENC_CALLING_MISSION_UUID >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1; else tmux display-message "No AgenC mission in this pane"; fi'

# sideShell — 🐚  Side Shell (-n C-p)
bind-key -n "C-p" run-shell 'AGENC_CALLING_MISSION_UUID=$(agenc tmux resolve-mission "#{pane_id}"); if [ -n "$AGENC_CALLING_MISSION_UUID" ]; then AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=#{pane_id} AGENC_CALLING_SESSION_NAME=#{session_name} tmux split-window -h -c "${AGENC_DIRPATH:-$HOME/.agenc}/missions/$AGENC_CALLING_MISSION_UUID/agent" $SHELL >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1; else tmux display-message "No AgenC mission in this pane"; fi'

# draft — 📝  Side Draft (-n C-')
bind-key -n "C-'" run-shell 'AGENC_CALLING_MISSION_UUID=$(agenc tmux resolve-mission "#{pane_id}"); if [ -n "$AGENC_CALLING_MISSION_UUID" ]; then AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=#{pane_id} AGENC_CALLING_SESSION_NAME=#{session_name} tmux split-window -h -d "agenc mission draft $AGENC_CALLING_MISSION_UUID" ; sleep 0.5 ; tmux copy-mode -t "$AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID" >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1; else tmux display-message "No AgenC mission in this pane"; fi'

# renameSession — ✨  Rename Session (-n C-.)
bind-key -n "C-." run-shell 'AGENC_CALLING_MISSION_UUID=$(agenc tmux resolve-mission "#{pane_id}"); if [ -n "$AGENC_CALLING_MISSION_UUID" ]; then AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=#{pane_id} AGENC_CALLING_SESSION_NAME=#{session_name} tmux display-popup -e AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=#{pane_id} -e AGENC_CALLING_SESSION_NAME=#{session_name} -E -w 68% -h 63% "agenc mission rename $AGENC_CALLING_MISSION_UUID" >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1; else tmux display-message "No AgenC mission in this pane"; fi'
